sentences.text: Leo is a teenager.
He has a black cat named Shadow.
In Leo’s house, Shadow is a very simple cat.
He is quiet and lazy.
He eats his food and then he sleeps.
He can sleep for many hours on the sofa.
Shadow does not like to play very much.
But Leo has a special account online.
It is for Shadow.
On this account, Shadow is not a simple cat.
He is an adventure cat!
Yesterday, Leo put a small hat on Shadow.
Shadow was sleeping.
Leo took a photo.
Online, Leo wrote, “Shadow is looking for treasure!”
The photo was very popular.
Everyone thinks Shadow is brave and exciting.
Leo’s friend, Maria, saw the photos.
She called Leo.
“Your cat is amazing!” she said.
“He is more exciting than my dog.
Can I please meet him tomorrow?
I want to see the famous adventure cat!”
Leo felt his face get hot.
He was very worried.
“Uh, yes.
You can come tomorrow,” he said slowly.
He was not happy.
He looked at Shadow.
The cat was sleeping on a pile of clean clothes.
He was not looking for treasure.
He was just a normal, sleepy cat.
"I must do something," Leo thought.
Today, Leo tried to play with Shadow.
He used a red toy mouse.
Shadow looked at the mouse for one second.
Then he closed his eyes again.
Leo sighed.
Soon, the doorbell rang.
It was Maria.
Leo opened the door.
He felt nervous.
Maria walked in and looked around.
“Where is the hero?” she asked with a big smile.
Leo pointed to the sofa.
Shadow was there, in a small, furry ball.
He was sleeping, of course.
Maria’s smile got bigger.
She went to the sofa quietly.
“Oh, Leo!
He is so sweet,” she whispered.
She did not look sad.
She looked very happy.
She gently petted Shadow’s back.
Shadow made a small, happy noise in his sleep.
“I thought you wanted an adventure cat,” Leo said.
“An adventure cat is fun online,” Maria said.
“But a sleepy, happy cat is better in real life.”
Leo felt good.
He sat down next to Maria.
They watched the lazy cat sleep.
Leo was happy with his real cat.
